scope.flow: _createCampaign minimum reward validation and storage of net amount
evidence: The `_createCampaign()` function validates the minimum reward requirement against the gross `amount` before fee deduction, but stores the net `realAmount` after fees. This allows campaigns where the effective reward rate falls below the intended minimum.

When fees are deducted, the actual stored `realAmount` can be significantly below what passed validation. With a 10% fee, a campaign passing with 101 tokens/hour gross actually delivers only 91 tokens/hour.
**Root cause:** The check at L544 uses `amount` (gross), but `realAmount` (net) is what's actually distributed.
- [DistributionCreator.sol L543-545](https://github.com/code-423n4/2025-11-merkl/blob/main/contracts/DistributionCreator.sol#L543-L545) - Validation uses gross amount
- [DistributionCreator.sol L552-553](https://github.com/code-423n4/2025-11-merkl/blob/main/contracts/DistributionCreator.sol#L552-L553) - Storage uses net amount
